query:
DELETE FROM qs_client_record c
                USING qs_user_record u
                WHERE c.user_id = $1
                    AND u.user_id = c.user_id
                    AND u.deleted_at IS NOT NULL
                    AND NOT EXISTS (
                        SELECT 1 FROM qs_queues q WHERE q.queue_id = c.client_id
                    )
